info.name: 19 - Member Workout Plans
info.description: Endpoints to assign workout plans to members, track progress, and manage plan status.

request.description:
### Endpoint Overview

Fetches a paginated list of member workout plan assignments for the current gym with dynamic sorting and filtering.

---

### Available Domain Attributes & Filter Reference

| Attribute Name | Data Type | Filter Support | Description / Allowed Values |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `Id` | `int` | Exact | Unique Identifier |
| `GymId` | `int` | Exact | Associated Gym ID |
| `WorkoutPlanId` | `int` | Exact | Assigned workout plan ID |
| `MemberId` | `int` | Exact | Gym person ID of the member |
| `Goal` | `string` | Searchable | Fitness goal (max 200 chars) |
| `StartDate` | `DateTime` | Between | ISO start date |
| `EndDate` | `DateTime?` | Between | ISO end date (nullable) |
| `Status` | `Enum (int)` | Exact | `0` = Active, `1` = Completed, `2` = Cancelled, `3` = Paused |
| `CreatedOn` | `DateTime` | Between | ISO creation date |
| `IsActive` | `bool` | Exact | Active status |

---

### Filter Usage Guide (For Request Body)

- **Exact Filters (`exactFilters`):** Pass attribute name with array of string/enum values. Example: `"exactFilters": { "Status": ["0"] }`
- **Between Filters (`betweenFilters`):** Pass attribute name with `min` and `max`. Example: `"betweenFilters": { "StartDate": { "min": "2026-01-01", "max": "2026-12-31" } }`

---

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Coach`, or `Member`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

item.name: Get Member Workout Plan By Id

request.description:
Fetches a single member workout plan assignment by ID.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Coach`, or `Member`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Assigns a workout plan to a member.

### Request Fields (`MemberWorkoutPlanCDTO`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `workoutPlanId` | `int` | Yes | Workout plan to assign |
| `memberId` | `int` | Yes | Gym person ID of the member |
| `goal` | `string?` | No | Max 200 characters |
| `startDate` | `DateTime` | Yes | ISO start date |
| `endDate` | `DateTime?` | No | ISO end date |

Returns `201 Created` with `Result<MemberWorkoutPlanRDTO>`.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, or `Coach`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.
